join.draw: A fair, random draw places you in one of these versions of the course, and you stay in it for the whole study:
version.fixed: The fixed lesson path: your companion is off.
version.chat_only: Lessons with your companion; personal changes are off.
version.supervisor: The full course, with your companion.
collected.study_code: Your study code (not your name or email)
collected.course_version: Which version of the course you used
collected.check_scores: Your scores on the study's check questions, and when you answered them
neverCollected.written_content: Anything you write in answers or messages
join.choice: Taking part is your choice. Saying no changes nothing about your course, your results or your access. You can leave at any time from My profile: from then on your data is left out, and you return to the course as everyone else has it.
join.agree: I have read this and agree to take part
join.failed: Your choice could not be saved. You have not joined.
taking.active: You are taking part. Your study code is {code}; the research team sees this code, never your name.
taking.ended: You are taking part (the study has now ended). Your study code is {code}; the research team sees this code, never your name.
leave.explain: From now on your data is left out of the study and your course returns to the standard version. Your learning progress is kept.
leave.failed: Your choice could not be saved. You are still in the study.
withdrawn: You left this study. Your data is not included and your course is the standard version.
join.usability: How long it takes you to find the next step in the app, how many other buttons you try first, and whether you get back to the same place after opening help. Only times and counts: never what you type or which lesson you are in.
taking.usability: For this study the app times how you find your way: times and counts only.
